why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 59 prints '29TH ST.' across its upper third and '30TH ST.' at its bottom with the adjoining-sheet numeral '65' in the corridor; sheet 65 prints '30TH ST.' at its top with the adjoining numeral '59', and '31ST ST.' at its bottom. The avenue-frontage hundred-block steps across the line: sheet 59's blocks between 29th and 30th carry the 2900 runs (2901 2903 2905 ... 2927 / 2902 2904 ... 2928), sheet 65's blocks carry the 3000 runs (3001 3003 ... 3027 / 3002 3004 ... 3028); above 29th on sheet 59 the runs are 2801-2828. The 30th St frontage numbers repeat on both faces - 1901 1903 1905 1907 1909 1911, 1913 1915 1917 1919 1921 1923, 2001 2003 ... 2011 and 1902 1904 ... 1912, 1914 ... 1924, 2002 ... 2012 - on sheet 59's south block faces and again on sheet 65's north faces. Block halves match: 'S.E. 64' and 'N.E. 89' on sheet 59 against 'S.W. 64' and 'N.W. 89' on sheet 65. Measurements: sheet 65 draws the whole corridor, north face at native y 98 and south face at 339 (241 px = 80 ft), centre 218; sheet 59 shows only the north face at native y 3548, so its centre is 3548 + 121 = 3669. Block depth 29th-30th is 906 px (~300 ft) on sheet 59 and 30th-31st 902 px on sheet 65, confirming a common scale. Detection candidates 2978 and 668 both lay inside blocks.
